title: One AI Conversation Can Use 500 Milliliters Of Water
hook: One AI conversation can use 500 milliliters of water.
closing: Invisible computing still consumes shared water, making data-center growth a local resource issue.
question: Would this change how you use AI?

segments.say: Microsoft's water use reached 6.4 million cubic meters, showing AI infrastructure has a physical footprint.
Google used 21.2 million cubic meters, revealing how quickly large technology systems multiply demand.
One AI conversation can use 500 milliliters, turning an invisible chat into a tangible bottle.
